learnings.claim: The SEC EDGAR API page (fetched 2026-10-09) states data.sec.gov submissions and XBRL APIs need no authentication or API key and update in real time (submissions typically under one second, XBRL under one minute), and the SEC developer resources page limits each user to no more than 10 requests per second across all machines and blocks unclassified bots.
learnings.decision: FINANCE_EDGAR_PRIMARY_GATE: company earnings/filing claims in the Finans mail should be verified against data.sec.gov submissions/companyfacts before secondary news; the fetcher must stay well under 10 req/s and identify itself, and an IP block is reported as BLOCKED, not as no news.
fallback_history: If data.sec.gov blocks the runner, fall back to the EDGAR Latest Filings RSS and mark the item unverified.
learnings.next_measurement: Verify one 8-K headline from the next Finans mail against data.sec.gov and record latency between filing time and the news item.
learnings.title: SEC EDGAR keyless API with 10 req/s fair access

learnings.claim: The Federal Reserve Board RSS page (fetched 2026-10-09) lists official feeds for all speeches and testimony, per-governor speeches, and data feeds for Foreign Exchange Rates (H.10) and Selected Interest Rates (H.15).
learnings.decision: FINANCE_FED_RSS_GATE: Fed rate/speech claims in the Finans mail are sourced from federalreserve.gov feeds first; secondary outlets (Investing.com etc.) are only context and must not be the sole source for a Fed statement.
fallback_history: If the feed is unreachable, use the federalreserve.gov newsevents page and mark freshness unknown.
learnings.next_measurement: Wire one Fed speeches feed into the finance runner and count items matched vs unmatched in the next three Finans mails.
learnings.title: Federal Reserve official RSS for speeches and rates
